Where the River Holds Us
with Totally Thames Trust

Sunday 27 September 2026 -
Mon 28 September 2026
4:30pm – 8:00pm

Part of the 2026 Thames Festival, Where the River Holds Us is a site-responsive multisensory opera exploring water, memory, climate and belonging, inviting audiences to experience the Thames as a living archive.

Gathering Rest
An Exhibition on Rest as an Act of Healing, Imagination and Embodiment (working title)

Saturday 23 January 2027 -
Sun 18 April 2027
11:00am – 4:30pm

Our 2027 exhibition Gathering Rest explores the restorative and transformative potential of rest in a culture that often prizes constant productivity.
